# privx_ca_certificate (Data Source)

PrivX authorizer root CA certificates. Use this to expose the PrivX CA public key(s). Changes to the returned certificates (for example a CA rotation) produce a plan diff, acting as a drift guard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the PrivX authorizer root CA certificates.
# Useful as a drift guard: if a CA is rotated in PrivX, the exposed
# public keys change and dependent configuration produces a plan diff.
data "privx_ca_certificate" "all" {}

# Optionally filter by access group.
data "privx_ca_certificate" "default_group" {
  access_group_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "privx_ca_public_keys" {
  description = "Public keys of the PrivX authorizer CA certificates"
  value       = [for ca in data.privx_ca_certificate.all.certificates : ca.public_key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_group_id` (String) Optional access group ID to filter the returned CA certificates.

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) List of CA certificates returned by the PrivX authorizer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `access_group_id` (String) Access group ID of the CA.
- `comment` (String) Optional human readable comment.
- `fingerprint_sha1` (String) SHA-1 fingerprint.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint.
- `group_id` (String) Group ID of the CA.
- `id` (String) CA UUID.
- `issuer` (String) Certificate issuer.
- `not_after` (String) Certificate validity end.
- `not_before` (String) Certificate validity start.
- `public_key` (String) CA public key.
- `public_key_string` (String) CA public key as a string.
- `serial` (String) Certificate serial number.
- `size` (Number) CA key size.
- `subject` (String) Certificate subject.
- `type` (String) CA key type.
- `x509_certificate` (String) X.509 certificate (PEM).
